cohesion.name: Nonexistent
cohesion.description: This nation pretty much only exists on paper, and there is no ruling authority whatsoever.

cohesion.name: Shattered
cohesion.description: This nation's central government has completely broken down into numerous micro-states.

cohesion.name: Fragmented
cohesion.description: This nation has been split into several powerful warlord states, each competing for control of the nation.

cohesion.name: Divided
cohesion.description: This nation has splintered into two or more opposed factions that are either in a civil war or approaching one.

cohesion.name: Fragile
cohesion.description: This nation's central government maintains a very fragile hold on its territories, and many of its citizens are considering revolt.

cohesion.name: Little
cohesion.description: This nation's established government has a weak, but relatively secure, control over its systems.

cohesion.name: Moderate
cohesion.description: This nation's ruling officials exercise a moderate amount of authority which, while by no means absolute, is generally respected.

cohesion.name: Reasonable
cohesion.description: This nation is reasonably stable, with its citizens and military supporting the current government.

cohesion.name: Good
cohesion.description: This nation is quite stable, without any major unrest.

cohesion.name: Great
cohesion.description: This nation has achieved a high level of cohesion, and anything more than minor protesting is completely unheard of.

cohesion.name: Remarkable
cohesion.description: This nation's government has achieved a level of cohesion among its citizens that is truly impressive.

cohesion.name: Fantastic
cohesion.description: This nation has a level of cohesion where even political squabbles are rare.

cohesion.name: Benchmark
cohesion.description: This nation's populace is fully united and eager to advance their homeland.

cohesion.name: Eerie
cohesion.description: This nation's populace is so compliant with the government and each other that visitors find them somewhat creepy.

cohesion.name: Absolute
cohesion.description: This nation, surely by some unethical means, has cultivated a populace with practically no free will.
